title: Continuous Differentiability of the Value Function for Infinite-Dimensional Finite-Horizon Optimal Stopping and Related Variational Inequalities
summary: This paper studies finite-horizon optimal stopping problems for semilinear stochastic evolution equations in real, separable Hilbert spaces, together with their associated parabolic variational inequalities. We prove continuous differentiability of the value function in infinite dimensions, thereby obtaining a smooth-fit principle for the corresponding optimal stopping problem. The analysis has two parts.
